symbol.name: calculateShipping
symbol.content: export function calculateShipping(items: CartItem[], region: Customer["region"]): number {   const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.unitPrice * item.quantity, 0);   if (subtotal >= 10000 && region === "local") return 0;   const weight = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.weight * item.quantity, 0);   return (region === "remote" ? 1200 : 500) + Math.max(0, Math.ceil(weight) - 1) * 200; }

process_symbols.name: checkoutOrder
process_symbols.content: export function checkoutOrder(input: OrderInput): SavedOrder {   const subtotal = calculateSubtotal(input.items);   const discount = applyDiscount(subtotal, input.coupon);   const shipping = calculateShipping(input.items, input.customer.region);   reserveStock(input.items);   return saveOrder(input.customer.id, {     subtotal, discount, shipping, total: subtotal - discount + shipping,   }); }

definitions.content: const results = cases.map(test => {   const quote = estimateOrder(test.input);   const order = submitOrder(test.input);   assert.equal(order.total, test.expected);   assert.equal(quote.total, order.total);   return { name: test.name, passed: true, total: order.total, quoteMatchesCheckout: true }; });

definitions.name: verify.ts
definitions.content: import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { submitOrder } from "./routes/order.ts"; import { estimateOrder } from "./services/estimate.ts"; import type { OrderInput } from "./types.ts"; const input: OrderInput = {   customer: { id: "buyer-01", region: "local" },   items: [{ sku: "BOOK", quantity: 2, unitPrice: 3000, weight: 0.5 }],   coupon: "SAVE10", }; const cases = [   { name: "local-discount", input, expected: 5900 },   { name: "remote-shipping", input: { ...input, customer: { id: "buyer-02", region: "remote" as const } }, expected: 6600 },   { name: "free-shipping", input: { ...input, items: [{ sku: "DESK", quantity: 1, unitPrice: 12000, weight: 3 }] }, expected: 10800 }, ]; const results = cases.map(test => {   const quote = estimateOrder(test.input);   const order = submitOrder(test.input);   assert.equal(order.total, test.expected);   assert.equal(quote.total, order.total);   return { name: test.name, passed: true, total: order.total, quoteMatchesCheckout: true }; }); assert.throws(() => submitOrder({ ...input, customer: { id: "", region: "local" } }), /Customer/); assert.throws(() => submitOrder({ ...input, items: [] }), /positive quantities/); console.log(JSON.stringify({ status: "passed", cases: results, invalidCustomerRejected: true, emptyCartRejected: true }, null, 2));

definitions.name: estimateOrder
definitions.content: export function estimateOrder(input: OrderInput): Quote {   const subtotal = calculateSubtotal(input.items);   const discount = applyDiscount(subtotal, input.coupon);   const shipping = shippingCost(input.items, input.customer.region);   return { subtotal, discount, shipping, total: subtotal - discount + shipping }; }

definitions.content: import { calculateShipping as shippingCost } from "./shipping.ts"; import { calculateSubtotal } from "./pricing.ts"; import { applyDiscount } from "./discount.ts"; import type { OrderInput, Quote } from "../types.ts"; // Quote calculation shares shipping logic through a named import alias. export function estimateOrder(input: OrderInput): Quote {   const subtotal = calculateSubtotal(input.items);   const discount = applyDiscount(subtotal, input.coupon);   const shipping = shippingCost(input.items, input.customer.region);   return { subtotal, discount, shipping, total: subtotal - discount + shipping }; }

definitions.name: shipping.ts
definitions.content: import type { CartItem, Customer } from "../types.ts"; // All money values are integer cents. Free shipping starts at a 10,000-cent subtotal. export function calculateShipping(items: CartItem[], region: Customer["region"]): number {   const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.unitPrice * item.quantity, 0);   if (subtotal >= 10000 && region === "local") return 0;   const weight = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.weight * item.quantity, 0);   return (region === "remote" ? 1200 : 500) + Math.max(0, Math.ceil(weight) - 1) * 200; }
